references.text: Mentions the same peoples who lived in Canaan: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, whom Israel was to drive out.
God's angel was to lead the Israelites in and drive out the Hivites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites.
God promised to drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites from the land.
God promised to drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
Mentions the seven nations of Canaan: Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites whom Israel was to drive out.
Commanded that Israel should strike these peoples with the ban: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
Mentions the same nations who lived in the land: Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.
The kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites gathered against Israel.
Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem, so they lived together with the Israelites.
Several tribes did not drive out the Canaanites but lived among them, which is the background for the situation in Judges 3:5.
Ezra confesses that the Israelites lived among the same nations: Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians and Amorites.
